answer.camera_language: Purposeful handheld advances replace decorative sway; downward evidence views give way to tightening faces, peaking on Dinu under personal pressure before withdrawing without an answer.
answer.arc: Contained discovery at 2–3, moral resistance at 3, a quiet pause, personal pressure rising to 5, then physical custody at 4 and unresolved release at 2.

clips.motivation: Establish the men's separation and the enclosing garage before attention contracts.
clips.opens_on: Wide entrance-side view, Nimal left and Dinu right beneath the roof structure.
clips.lands_on: The same wide view with the closed box between the separated men.
clips.angle_reason: The elevated entrance view makes the roof and enclosure dominate both men equally.

clips.camera_sentence: A slightly high wide frame holds above the entrance, keeping both men beneath the roof structure with the closed box between them.

clips.direction: straight toward the space between both men

clips.why: Tension 2: a visible handheld advance tightens the shared frame instead of relying on sway that Omni ignores.
clips.camera_sentence: From an eye-level two-shot, the camera moves slowly closer while both men wait, then settles on their waists and faces with the closed box between them.

clips.camera_sentence: From a slightly high close-up, the camera pushes slowly closer as Dinu's eyes lower and return, then stops on an extreme close-up containing his eyes and closed mouth.
